hints.tr: Dört tablo. İki siparişin çalışanı yok (`employee_id` `NULL`): `employees`'a `JOIN` ile bağlanırsa o siparişler düşüyor, `LEFT JOIN` gerekiyor. Boş adı `COALESCE(e.name, 'Unassigned')`.
hints.en: Four tables. Two orders have no employee (`employee_id` is `NULL`): joining `employees` with `JOIN` drops those orders, you need `LEFT JOIN`. The empty name becomes `COALESCE(e.name, 'Unassigned')`.

hints.tr: Kalem sayısı ve tutar için siparişe göre grupla: `GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date, c.name, e.name`. Görünüm `CREATE VIEW dbo.order_summary AS ...` ile, içinde `ORDER BY` yok.
hints.en: Group by order for the line count and amount: `GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date, c.name, e.name`. The view is `CREATE VIEW dbo.order_summary AS ...`, with no `ORDER BY` inside.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE VIEW dbo.order_summary AS
SELECT o.id, o.order_date,
       c.name AS customer,
       COALESCE(e.name, 'Unassigned') AS employee,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date, c.name, e.name;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE VIEW dbo.order_summary AS
SELECT o.id, o.order_date,
       c.name AS customer,
       COALESCE(e.name, 'Unassigned') AS employee,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date, c.name, e.name;
```

checks.query: SELECT id, order_date, customer, employee, item_count, total FROM dbo.order_summary ORDER BY id;
